Different wording and different symbol names still count. An item may carry more detail than the review, such as a second reason, a consequence, or a symbol name; the review still states it when it gives the main fact and says nothing that contradicts the rest. Answer no when the review is silent on the main fact, states the opposite, or states a weaker version that changes what the reader would conclude. On yes, quote the review sentence that states it.",
